cards.narrative: Aranda is hit by a pitch to put a second runner on.

cards.label: THROUGH 4TH
cards.subtitle: Still scoreless. Both pitchers in command.

cards.description: Jonny DeLuca doubles on a sharp line drive to center fielder Myles Straw. Jonathan Aranda scores.
Chandler Simpson singles on a ground ball to right fielder Yohendrick Piñango. Jonny DeLuca scores.

cards.narrative: Corbin punches out Caminero to end the half.

cards.label: THROUGH 6TH
cards.subtitle: TB lead by 2. The score holds.

cards.label: LATE INNINGS
cards.subtitle: TB lead by 2. Every runner matters now.

cards.description: Daulton Varsho singles on a ground ball to center fielder Jonny DeLuca.
cards.narrative: Varsho lines a single into play.

cards.description: Myles Straw singles on a ground ball to third baseman Junior Caminero. Daulton Varsho to 2nd.
cards.narrative: Straw singles and pushes the runner along.
Walls works the count and draws a walk.

cards.description: Cedric Mullins singles on a sharp line drive to right fielder Myles Straw.
cards.narrative: Mullins lines a single into play.

cards.description: Louis Varland intentionally walks Jonathan Aranda.
cards.narrative: Aranda works a walk to add a runner late.

cards.description: Jonny DeLuca grounds into a force out, fielded by second baseman Ernie Clement. Cedric Mullins scores. Jonathan Aranda out at 2nd. Jonny DeLuca to 1st. Throwing error by second baseman Ernie Clement.
cards.narrative: DeLuca gets retired but a run crosses on the play.
